title_zh: AppDeltaWorld：面向移动GUI智能体的转移约束增量代码世界模型
one_line: Mobile world model generating next-screen HTML as a delta from retrieved app-specific references; its filtered rollouts, mixed with public data, modestly lift online success.
one_line_zh: 以检索到的应用参考HTML为基础增量生成下一屏的世界模型，其过滤后的轨迹与公开数据混合训练，小幅提升在线成功率。

title_zh: 基于免回归布局感知匹配的无幻觉GUI定位
one_line: Frozen MLLM elaborates the instruction; a Text/Icon detector proposes boxes and CLIP with a linear geometry offset picks one; offline grounding and step-accuracy gains only.

title_zh: LookAgain：基于视觉锚定反思的闭环GUI定位
one_line: Grounder iterates locate (marker plus crop of its own guess) and confirm/refuse, trained by SFT cold start then GRPO; offline grounding gains only.

title_zh: CoAdapt-GUI：面向未见GUI应用的工作流上下文与策略联合自适应
one_line: Test-time adaptation on unseen apps jointly evolves a reward-rated workflow context and a LoRA policy from own rollouts; held-out apps and templates, multi-run.
one_line_zh: 在未见应用上测试时自适应，用自身轨迹与奖励同时演化工作流上下文并更新LoRA策略；在独立的应用与任务模板上评估。

online_eval.quote: Our primary metric is success rate (SR), defined as the percentage of held-out evaluation episodes successfully completed according to the benchmark’s programmatic evaluator.

held_out_env.quote: We assign 12 apps with 96 templates to the source set and the remaining 13 apps with 95 templates to the disjoint target set.

variance.quote: Reported results are from AndroidWorld-Generalization ( Gu et al. 2026 ) ; our results are mean \pm standard deviation over five runs.

strong_baselines.quote: Policy-Only TTA keeps the workflow context fixed and updates only the policy adapter from target adaptation rollouts.

budget_matched.quote: Context-Only TTA and CoAdapt-GUI receive the same adaptation tasks and rollout budget, but are run independently and can therefore collect different policy-dependent trajectories

cost_reported.quote: Experiments were run on NVIDIA H200 GPUs with 141 GB of memory; one 20-round target-app adaptation run required approximately 9–10 GPU-hours on average.

component_ablation.quote: The cumulative context path—Static Context Transfer followed by Context-Only TTA—reaches 48.1%, 9.5 points above the Base Policy, whereas Policy-Only TTA reaches 40.0%, a gain of only 1.4 points.

evidence_level.quote: The target split contains five disjoint apps, with eight adaptation instances per app (40 total) and 48 held-out evaluation instances.

title_zh: SynWeaver：基于网站先验的网页智能体任务与轨迹协同合成
one_line: DFS website maps train a site-aware task proposer; teachers co-refine task and trajectory, then verify; SFT gains on WebArena and out-of-domain WebVoyager.
one_line_zh: 以DFS网站地图训练具备站点先验的任务提议模型，教师模型协同修正任务与轨迹并校验；SFT后在WebArena及域外WebVoyager上提升。

online_eval.quote: On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, our method reaches 19.91, outperforming the strongest baseline, SynthAgent, by 3.10 points and the vanilla model by 7.96 points.

held_out_env.quote: SynWeaver synthesizes data on the five WebArena websites and is evaluated in-domain on WebArena and out-of-domain on WebVoyager.

strong_baselines.quote: We compare against NNetNav ( Murty et al., 2024 ) , OS-Genesis ( Sun et al., 2025a ) , and SynthAgent ( Wang et al., 2025b )

budget_matched.quote: For fair comparison, each baseline is trained on 1,000 public trajectories, so SynWeaver uses a smaller but more structured and validated training set.

cost_reported.quote: This higher retention directly lowers synthesis cost, reducing it from $0.091 to $0.085 despite better task success and data quality.

title_zh: UI-Mate：借助上下文示范推进开源权重基础GUI智能体
one_line: Open-weight desktop agent from a verifier-bundled data engine, SFT and online RL, plus demonstration-to-workflow conditioning; strong OSWorld-Verified and WindowsAgentArena results.
one_line_zh: 基于带验证器的数据引擎、SFT与在线RL训练的开源桌面智能体，并可将示范转为子任务工作流作为上下文；在OSWorld-Verified与WAA上表现强劲。

online_eval.quote: UI-Mate-27B achieves an average score of 77.0\% on OSWorld-Verified, outperforming the general-purpose Kimi-K2.6 ( 73.1\% ) and Qwen3.7-Plus ( 73.3\% )

strong_baselines.quote: It also substantially outperforms ScaleCUA-Qwen3.5-9B, a specialized agent built on the same base model, in both overall success (34.00% vs. 16.33%) and progress (66.55% vs. 38.27%).

budget_matched.quote: Unless otherwise stated, all systems are evaluated in the same initialized target environments with identical task instructions, interaction budgets, and executable evaluators.

cost_reported.quote: The median trajectory contains 68 decision turns for Kimi-K2.6 and 71 for UI-Mate-27B, and 40 UI-Mate trajectories extend to at least 100 turns.

component_ablation.quote: On the 33-task self-demo subset, one demonstration raises strict success from 17.2% to 35.4% and progress from 67.9% to 81.1%

AP8.quote: All systems use screenshot observations, PyAutoGUI control, 1920{\times}1080 environments, and a nominal 200-turn budget, with one rollout per task.

title_zh: Wuying-Browser-Agent：面向真实世界的长程基础浏览器智能体
one_line: Browser agent trained with recovery- and complex-UI curriculum SFT, then online GRPO with progress shaping and divergence weighting; live-web gains over SFT across three scales.
one_line_zh: 浏览器智能体先经含错误恢复与复杂控件数据的课程SFT，再以进度奖励塑形与分歧加权的在线GRPO优化；三种规模在真实网页基准上均优于SFT。

online_eval.quote: Wuying-Browser-Agent-27B achieves 80.6\% on WebVoyager, 66.7\% on Online-Mind2Web, and 65.1\% on BrowserBench, establishing a new open-source state of the art on browser-use benchmarks.

variance.quote: Because each task is evaluated with exactly one rollout, Pass@1 is equivalent to single-rollout success rate.

title_zh: 从计算机使用轨迹中归纳任务模型

title_zh: 超越成败：面向GUI智能体的长度感知对比学习
one_line: Contrastive RLVR objective prefers shorter successes and later-diverging failures in online OSWorld RL; small gains over GRPO/REAL, trained and evaluated on the same tasks.
